title: More photo albums for supporters
summary: Anyone who has supported the game can now keep more than one photo album: one extra for any donation, and 10 for every A$10. Once your first album is full, an album you find on the train is your newest album half the time, and one of your full albums the rest of the time. A crafted album is always your newest one.
highlights: Your photo album now follows you to every computer you play on
